sources.quote: From ні (ni) + би (by). Cognate with Belarusian ні́бы (níby), Polish niby. Compare Old Ruthenian небы (neby, “like, as if”), Russian как бы (kak by), Czech and Polish jakoby.

sources.quote: Inherited from Proto-Slavic *pozorъ from *po- + *zьrěti. Equivalent to по- (po-) + зрі́ти (zríty). Cognates include Russian and Bulgarian позор (pozor), Czech and Slovak pozor, Polish pozór, and Serbo-Croatian pòzor.

позір.text: Inherited from Proto-Slavic *pozorъ from *po- + *zьrěti. Equivalent to по- (po-) + зрі́ти (zríty). Cognates include Russian and Bulgarian позор (pozor), Czech and Slovak pozor, Polish pozór, and Serbo-Croatian pòzor.
